scope.organization_scope: explicit registry assignment; no automatic assignment to every tenant

selection_proposal.clock: database transaction timestamp, compared as UTC instants
selection_proposal.eligible: status approved, approval evidence present, effective_from <= created_at, effective_until null or created_at < effective_until, and explicit organization/exposure scope matches
selection_proposal.overlap: reject overlapping approved assignments at registration; if multiple still match at creation, fail closed without choosing newest
selection_proposal.no_match: reject case creation; no draft/pilot/default fallback
selection_proposal.case_binding: persist selected policy_version and approved artifact hash in the same transaction as case and creator membership; never reselect an existing case
selection_proposal.approval_boundary: operator registers an externally approved artifact; no new business role or approval API

inherited_invariants: creator belongs to organization and gets only this case membership in the creation transaction
identity mismatch or unresolved identity cannot be waived into a positive legal-entity conclusion
missing financial inputs block numeric assessment; missing method separately blocks numeric assessment
waiver retains missing finding/limitation and never means verified
proposed transaction does not certify that an obligation or payment occurred
optional missing information is a limitation, not an invented numerical penalty

checklist_proposal.waiver_scope: provisional document review only; no verified identity conclusion while source missing/conflicting
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: request source or retain explicit missing limitation; legal-entity conclusion unavailable

checklist_proposal.when: numeric assessment requested; exact financial set remains controlled by the separate approved method
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: numeric blocked; documentary review may continue with limitations

checklist_proposal.when: required for active transaction assertions; proposed case may instead carry explicit proposed scope and limitations
checklist_proposal.waiver_scope: documentary review only, never certify contract existence or realized obligation
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: do not treat transaction as supported active obligation; retain proposed/unsupported limitation for review

checklist_proposal.when: case condition or actual claim relies on delivery/acceptance as payment trigger or performance evidence
checklist_proposal.waiver_scope: missing-support handling only; trigger satisfaction remains unknown
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: flag unsupported performance/trigger; do not mark condition satisfied

checklist_proposal.when: a paid/received actual claim is used in transaction review
checklist_proposal.waiver_scope: missing-support handling only; no verified payment or computed settlement from waiver
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: retain source claim as unverified or incomplete, never infer zero or nonpayment

checklist_proposal.when: PREPAYMENT relies on a refund or guarantee condition; or any core case explicitly claims a guarantee
checklist_proposal.waiver_scope: missing-document handling only; no guarantee coverage or refund entitlement inferred
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: flag unsupported safeguard, do not substitute financial health for delivery guarantee

checklist_proposal.when: not activated by a specific claim/condition; the activated source requirement above takes precedence
checklist_proposal.missing_behavior: limitation only; no automatic score penalty

approval_questions: Approve or amend each checklist classification, activation condition and waiver scope
